To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we developed a step-by-step process for developing adaptation plans for biodiversity conservation projects that was used by a wide range of projects to consider climate impacts and develop adaptation strategies.

we developed a step-by-step process to help biodiversity conservation projects adapt to climate change and that we applied this process to 20 projects in diverse geographies, which resulted in the identification of 176 likely climate-related impacts on the projects and the development of adaptation strategies to address these impacts.
1) conservation projects are not well prepared to address climate impacts, but 2) a simple step-by-step process can help project teams develop climate adaptation strategies.

the question of whether conservation projects can be designed to be resilient in the face climate change.
developing a process for developing and testing climate adaptation strategies for biodiversity conservation projects.

how to make the most effective use of the limited resources available to address the impacts of climate change on biodiversity conservation projects, and how to ensure that the resources are used to their best advantage.

this paper provides the first comprehensive assessment of climate impacts and adaptation strategies for a wide range of conservation projects, and that this approach is an effective means to develop adaptation strategies.
the approach described here can be used to help projects adapt to climate change.

the most important thing is to have a process for assessing climate impacts and developing strategies to address them.
